why_agent_cannot: an X account post or follow is required
what_human_must_do: Open token.chimpx.ai and scroll to the airdrop checker.
Paste your Solana or BNB Chain address and press Check. "You'll never be asked to sign or send anything here." A wallet outside the list shows: "This wallet isn't in the snapshot."
If your allocation is on a BNB Chain wallet, you'll need a Solana wallet too: "How to link it is announced before claims open."

Wait for the claim, about a month after launch, and follow @ChimpxAI for the date. Warning ChimpX says: "We will never DM you first. Never share your seed phrase or private keys." Anyone offering an early claim or a sale spot by message is a scammer.
costs: Checking costs nothing and needs no wallet connection. ChimpX hasn't said what claiming will cost; on Solana it should be a small network fee. Earning more HOOTs was never free in practice: the app's free plan charges a "1.0% flat swap fee", monthly plans cost $9 or $19, and a SuperChimp NFT that doubled HOOTs sold for 0.20 SOL.
risks: ChimpX publishes no terms of service, no company name and no list of excluded countries. Bots and multi-wallets are cut: "No appeals.No exceptions." $CHIMP was sold several times before this launch. In February 2026 ChimpX said it "Raised $100K on @Spores_Network" and promised a "Listing Price: $0.40" on PancakeSwap that never happened. A further public sale was set for 12 October on Metaplex.
